basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Project Research Scientist, Project Technical Support and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Neuroanesthesiology & Neurocritical Care, JPNATC, All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, has invited applications for three temporary posts, one each of Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical), Project Technical Support - III and Project Technical Support - I, in an ICMR-funded research project on recovery of consciousness after severe traumatic brain injury. content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Project Posts
content_sections.text: The posts are temporary positions under a research project funded by ICMR. The project is based in the Department of Neuroanesthesiology & Neurocritical Care at JPNATC, AIIMS, New Delhi. The Principal Investigator named in the notice is Dr. Ashish Bindra, and the Project Code is I-2051.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists three posts with one vacancy each, 3 in total. The notice does not print a category-wise break-up of the posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice does not list a desirable qualification for any post. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. The notice does not print a date for counting age. The notice states the upper age relaxation for SC/ST (up to 5 years) and OBC (up to 3 years) as applying for all categories.

rows.minimum_essential_qualification: Post Graduate Degree including the integrated PG degrees. For Engineering/IT/CS - Four-year Graduate Degree.
Three years graduate degree in relevant subject/field + three years of experience in relevant subject/field; OR postgraduate degree in relevant subject/field.
10th pass with Diploma (MLT/DMLT/ITI) and two years of experience in the relevant subject/field; OR 3 years graduate degree in relevant subject/field with one year of relevant experience.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Each post carries its own remuneration, with HRA as admissible (30%) added on top: ₹56,000 for Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical), ₹28,000 for Project Technical Support - III and ₹18,000 for Project Technical Support - I. The posts are temporary and the project duration is 3 years (2026–2029). Joining is planned for December 2026 (tentatively).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice asks interested candidates to scan the QR code printed in it and submit the application that way. The last date for submission of applications is 10 December 2026. The notice names no documents to attach and gives no postal address or email address for applications.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts: one each of Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical), Project Technical Support - III and Project Technical Support - I.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS project posts?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical)?
faq.answer: A Post Graduate Degree including the integrated PG degrees. For Engineering/IT/CS, a Four-year Graduate Degree is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Project Technical Support - I?
faq.answer: 10th pass with Diploma (MLT/DMLT/ITI) and two years of experience in the relevant subject/field; OR 3 years graduate degree in relevant subject/field with one year of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for these AIIMS posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years for Project Research Scientist-I and Project Technical Support - III, and 28 years for Project Technical Support - I.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the AIIMS project posts?
faq.answer: Project Research Scientist-I gets ₹56,000, Project Technical Support - III ₹28,000 and Project Technical Support - I ₹18,000, each plus HRA as admissible (30%).

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the remuneration?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice gives each remuneration as the amount plus HRA as admissible (30%).

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Scan the QR code given in the notice to submit the application on or before 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the AIIMS project appointment?
faq.answer: The project duration is 3 years (2026–2029), and the posts are temporary. Joining is tentatively in December 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be admissible for attending the interview.
